name: modo-ai-skills
description: Assess how well you work with AI against Modo's public rubric: scored prompt by prompt, with a level, confidence, run agreement and quoted evidence for five capabilities, from this chat or a chat you paste. Then get help with one capability, a Modo card and a PDF report. For your own development, not for hiring decisions.

defaultPrompt: Assess this chat with Modo AI Skills
